name: path-utils
description: Essential path manipulation utilities from MSYS2 and MinGW toolchain

tools.description: Extract filename component from file path by removing directory prefix
tools.usage:
basename /path/to/file.txt # Returns: file.txt
basename /path/to/file.txt .txt # Returns: file
basename $(pwd) # Get current directory name

tools.description: Path format converter between Windows and UNIX-style paths
tools.usage:
convert -w /c/path # Convert to Windows format: C:\path
convert -u 'C:\path' # Convert to UNIX format: /c/path

tools.description: Convert between MSYS2/Cygwin and Windows path formats with comprehensive options
tools.usage:
cygpath -w /home/user # Convert to Windows path
cygpath -u 'C:\Users' # Convert to UNIX path
cygpath -am /tmp # Absolute mixed path

tools.description: Extract directory component from file path by removing filename suffix
tools.usage:
dirname /path/to/file.txt # Returns: /path/to
dirname $(pwd)/script.sh # Get parent directory
cd $(dirname $0) # Go to script directory

tools.description: Create hard links to files for space-efficient file duplication
tools.usage:
hardlink source.txt target.txt # Create hard link
hardlink -n source.txt # Count existing links
hardlink -v source.txt backup.txt # Verbose linking

tools.description: Create file links with extended options and validation
tools.usage:
link -s source.txt symlink.txt # Create symbolic link
link -f source.txt hardlink.txt # Force link creation
link -v source.txt target.txt # Verbose link operation

tools.description: UNIX-style link creator for symbolic and hard links with standard options
tools.usage:
ln -s /path/to/file symlink # Create symbolic link
ln file1.txt file2.txt # Create hard link
ln -sf new_target existing_link # Force symbolic link

tools.description: Validate file path names for portability and system compatibility
tools.usage:
pathchk /path/to/file # Check path validity
pathchk -p /portable/path # Check POSIX portability
pathchk -P /strict/path # Strict portability check

tools.description: Read and resolve symbolic links to display target paths
tools.usage:
readlink symlink.txt # Show link target
readlink -f symlink.txt # Canonicalize path
readlink -e symlink.txt # Require existing target

tools.description: Resolve absolute canonical path by following all symbolic links
tools.usage:
realpath file.txt # Get absolute path
realpath -s symlink # Don't resolve final symlink
realpath --relative-to=/base /path # Get relative path

tools.description: Remove single file or symbolic link using UNIX-style unlink operation
tools.usage:
unlink file.txt # Remove file
unlink symlink # Remove symbolic link
unlink /tmp/tempfile # Remove temporary file

tools.description: Windows Message Compiler for creating message resource files from text definitions
tools.usage:
windmc messages.mc # Compile message file
windmc -h include_dir messages.mc # Set header directory
windmc -r res_dir messages.mc # Set resource directory

tools.description: Windows Resource Compiler for converting resource files to object format
tools.usage:
windres resource.rc resource.o # Compile resource
windres -i input.rc -o output.o # Specify input/output
windres --define MACRO=VALUE resource.rc # Define macro
